reason: While src/sentry/testutils/factories.py:353 checks `if client_sample_rate:`, 0 and 0.0 are not valid error sampling rates in Sentry: src/sentry/event_manager.py:786 strictly requires `0 < client_sample_rate <= 1` and rejects 0 as invalid (also tested in tests/sentry/event_manager/test_event_manager.py:3103-3104), so omitting `sample_rate` for 0/0.0 matches production behavior.
